title: ESH Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing
summary: ESH Acquisition Corp., a SPAC listed on Nasdaq Capital Market (ticker ESHA), received a deficiency notice from Nasdaq on April 17, 2026 for failing to timely file its Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The company announced on April 23, 2026 that its board decided to cease operations as of April 30, 2026 and will redeem all public shares from its trust account, as it will not complete an initial business combination before the June 13, 2026 deadline.
key_points: Company received Nasdaq deficiency notice on April 17, 2026 for non-compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to missing Form 10-K filing
Nasdaq granted 60-day period to submit compliance plan; up to 180-day extension possible until October 14, 2026
Board resolved to cease operations and wind down on April 30, 2026 (Record Date)
All public shares will be redeemed pro rata from trust account
Company will not consummate initial business combination before June 13, 2026 SPAC deadline
Trading continues uninterrupted on Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol ESHA until Record Date
